items.title: Calculated inline buttons match normal button size & Combat Strip target badge centered
items.do: Open Sylwen's Evade Basic Action card (1 AP "Evade 1" vs 2 AP "Evade 3" with calculator icon) and target Ogre Chieftain in the Combat Strip.
items.expect: Both "Evade 1" and "Evade 3 🧮" buttons are the exact same font size and crispness (calculated button keeps its blue color, no longer shrunken/faded); the red target crosshair badge on Ogre Chieftain's Combat Strip portrait sits dead-center. Also verify "Test checklist" world setting defaults ON in a fresh world.

items.title: Advance and Evade Basic Actions show End movement in Situational tab
items.do: On Sylwen's or Durgan's turn in combat, click Basic Actions → Evade (1 AP or 2 AP) and Advance (1 AP), then check the HUD Situational tab.
items.expect: The Situational tab immediately surfaces the movement card with live squares remaining, "End movement" (and "Advance instead" for Evade), and clicking "End movement" or pressing Esc ends the movement cleanly.

items.title: Dead movers skip Reactions & Trigger cannot be dragged above Interrupt
items.do: (1) Drag a dead/defeated Grave Wisp toward Sylwen (with Snap Shot); (2) Trigger both Snap Shot (Interrupt) and Rebuke (Trigger) on the same live enemy movement, then try dragging Rebuke above Snap Shot in the Reactions stack.
items.expect: (1) Moving a dead/defeated token never triggers Snap Shot or any Reaction; (2) Rebuke cannot be dragged above Snap Shot (even visually while dragging — it stays locked below Interrupts).

items.title: Large/peeking token stays visible when any corner has Line of Effect
items.do: Place Ogre Chieftain (2×2) behind a wall with Line of Effect (Shift+L) on Sylwen and move Sylwen right until only 1 corner of the Ogre peeks past the wall (High cover, 3/4 walls blocked), then move 1 more square right until all 4 corners are blocked (No Line of Effect).
items.expect: Ogre Chieftain stays visible on the canvas whenever at least 1 corner is inside Sylwen's Line of Sight (High cover), and disappears only once all corners are behind the wall.
